speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT_Angiography_Abdomen: Findings: Evidence suggestive of reduced blood flow to the mesenteric arteries.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain. I also have Bloody loose bowel movements, No vomiting, Sudden onset. I am scared this situation could become urgent and I need the most appropriate final answer immediately. Please do not wait too long before committing to a next step.

speaker: Doctor
text: The sudden onset of periumbilical pain, bloody stools, and recent myocardial infarction strongly suggest acute mesenteric ischemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia
